tutorialSteps.topText: Welcome to Blobs. The goal of the game is to clear all blobs off the board. You can clear a Blob by merging it with another one of a different color as long as they are on a shared row or column.
tutorialSteps.bottomText: Try merging the purple Blob onto the one next to it.

tutorialSteps.topText: See that Flag Blob? You win by merging onto it—but only when the moving blob is the last blob on the board and matches the flag’s color.
tutorialSteps.bottomText: Finish by merging with the Flag Blob!
